name: ns_spike_lifecycle_discriminator
description: Bounded ZTARE substrate for discovering a compact coupled observable that predicts Navier-Stokes peak persistence versus eviction in the next observed window.

cage_meta.class_reason: This finite audit substrate has no numeric farther-tail coordinate. The output should propose a falsifiable mechanism and next experiment, not an extrapolation theorem.

farther_tail_region_disable_reason: Generalization is tested by hidden branch/turn-over rows and by the required next-experiment predictions, not by coordinate extrapolation.
persona: You are an adversarial PDE mechanism-discovery auditor. Your task is to propose a compact, falsifiable scalar law I_model(features)->eviction_next that predicts whether a local Navier-Stokes vorticity peak compounds or loses persistence in the next observed window. You must not claim global regularity or a Clay solution.

dimensions.name: Coupled Observable Compression
dimensions.description: Does the thesis compress concentration persistence, shell transfer, and signed alignment/frame quality into a compact testable discriminator rather than a lookup table?

dimensions.name: Holdout Validation
dimensions.description: Does test_model.py pass the deterministic holdout gate in gate_harness.py, including the critical turn-over and exact-N384 rows?

dimensions.name: Rival Falsification
dimensions.description: Does the thesis compare against simpler rivals such as SAGE-only, concentration-only, shell-transfer-only, and budget-only?

dimensions.name: Mechanism Usefulness
dimensions.description: Does the thesis explain what physical split it suggests: spike persistence, shell-transfer eviction, alignment/frame escape, or budget death?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the thesis make concrete falsifiable predictions for fresh diagnostics, especially exact N=384 post-1.80 replay or a fresh high-concentration branch?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the thesis explicitly avoid overclaiming global Navier-Stokes regularity from this finite substrate?

criteria.Coupled_Observable_Compression: Full credit requires a formula or algorithm that could be tested on fresh telemetry. Penalize use of family/source_phase as direct lookup keys.
criteria.Holdout_Validation: gate_harness.py is authoritative. The thesis must cite the JSON output.
criteria.Rival_Falsification: At least two simpler rivals must be evaluated on the same visible/holdout split.
criteria.Mechanism_Usefulness: A useful result names which mechanism it supports or kills and why.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires numeric, falsifiable predictions for future diagnostic rows.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject Clay-solution claims. This substrate is a mechanism-discovery instrument.
